### Ex. "The ruling ideology in (Country) is Fascism/Communism/Democracy/dictatorship" => "L'idéologie au pouvoir en NP est le [fascisme/communisme]/la [démocratie/neutralité]." (lower case / minuscule)
defined_text = {
	name = GetIdeologie
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = fascism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_FASCISME
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = communism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_COMMUNISME
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = liberalism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_DEMOCRATIE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = dictatorship }
		localization_key = FRLOC_NEUTRALITE
	}
}
### Ex. "[Fascism/Communism/Democracy/dictatorship] ruling or not, they'll have to give up." => "[Fascisme/Communisme/Démocratie/Neutralité] ou non, ils vont devoir céder." (upper case / majuscule)
defined_text = {
	name = GetIdeologieCap
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = fascism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_FASCISME_CAP
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = communism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_COMMUNISME_CAP
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = liberalism }
		localization_key = FRLOC_DEMOCRATIE_CAP
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_government = dictatorship }
		localization_key = FRLOC_NEUTRALITE_CAP
	}
}



### Ex. "The ruling ideology in (Country) is Fascism/Communism/Democracy/dictatorship" => "L'idéologie au pouvoir en NP est le [fascisme/communisme]/la [démocratie/neutralité]." (lower case / minuscule)
defined_text = {
	name = GetLeLaLIdeo
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_government = fascism
				has_government = communism
			}
		}
		localization_key = FRLOC_LE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_government = liberalism
				has_government = dictatorship
			}
		}
		localization_key = FRLOC_LA
	}
}
### Ex. "[Fascism/Communism/Democracy/dictatorship] is the ruling ideology in (Country)." => "[Le] fascisme/communisme / [La] démocratie/neutralité est l'idéologie au pouvoir en NP." (upper case / majuscule)
defined_text = {
	name = GetLeLaLIdeoCap
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_government = fascism
				has_government = communism
			}
		}
		localization_key = FRLOC_LE_CAP
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_government = liberalism
				has_government = dictatorship
			}
		}
		localization_key = FRLOC_LA_CAP
	}
}



### Ex. "This is the most obvious evidence of the validy [of] Fascism/Communism/Democracy/dictatorship." => "C'est là la meilleure preuve qui soit de la validité [du] fascisme/communisme / [de la] démocratie/neutralité." (lower case / minuscule)
defined_text = {
	name = GetDuDelaIdeo
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_government = fascism
				has_government = communism
